description: Reference to instructions for disassembling the battery pack and its components.
notes: 按工程化拆解手册细项表述；官方父字段未独立设置该手册子键。

description: Reference to component part numbers and contact details for replacement spare parts.
notes: 工程化行同时包含零部件编号和备件来源信息，按官方父字段整体表述。

description: Postal address of the source supplying replacement battery spare parts.
notes: 备件来源的工程化地址拆分项，官方1.0.0未独立定义地址子字段。

description: Website address of the source supplying replacement battery spare parts.
notes: 备件来源的工程化网址拆分项，官方1.0.0未独立定义网址子字段。

description: Email address for contacting the source of replacement battery spare parts.
notes: 备件来源的工程化邮箱拆分项，官方1.0.0未独立定义邮箱子字段。

description: Reference to safety measures for handling and dismantling the battery.
Guidance explaining how end-users can help prevent batteries from becoming waste.
Guidance explaining end-users' role in the separate collection of waste batteries.
Guidance on battery collection, preparation for second life, and treatment at the end of life.
notes: 这是相关废电池管理子项的工程化汇总行，不是官方1.0.0独立同名字段。

description: Information identifying facilities that prepare batteries for repurposing into a different application.
Information identifying facilities that prepare used batteries for reuse in their original application.
Information identifying locations designated for the separate collection of waste batteries.
Information identifying take-back services and collection points for waste batteries.
Instructions describing safety precautions for handling and managing waste batteries.
Information identifying facilities that treat waste batteries at the end of life.
Usable battery energy established during vehicle certification under the applicable test procedure.
notes: 认证可用电量是SOCE的工程化辅助量，官方1.0.0未独立定义该字段；不将旧描述中的标准名称升级为统一强制测试标准。

description: Usable energy available at the current stage of the battery's service life.
notes: 剩余可用电量是SOCE的工程化辅助量，官方1.0.0未独立定义该字段；不得与Ah单位的remainingCapacity混同。

description: Usable battery energy at a given time, expressed as a percentage of certified usable energy.
Histogram of periodically recorded battery state-of-charge values during battery use.
notes: 按格式列中的直方图表达，避免将其描述为瞬时SOC标量；未指定记录或同步频率。

description: Battery capacity expressed in ampere-hours under the specified reference conditions.
notes: 此行为公开batteryCapacity，与第150行受限动态ratedCapacity分开；不解释为remainingCapacity。

description: Capacity remaining in the battery at the current stage of its service life.
Percentage decrease in battery capacity over time and use relative to its original rated capacity.
Nominal voltage used to identify the battery, with the relevant temperature conditions.
notes: 未将valueRange解释为电压上下限；官方该范围用于相关温度条件。

description: Minimum and maximum battery voltage values under the applicable reference conditions.
notes: E列为电压范围、D列为最低电压；按工程化电压范围描述，但须确认是否同时承载最高电压。不得把官方电压对象中的温度valueRange当电压范围。

description: Initial battery power capability measured at 20% state of charge under specified reference conditions.
notes: 20% SOC来自本表工程化细项，官方originalPowerCapability单值模型没有规定必须取20%；与第108行存在重复及映射口径歧义，需保留确认。

description: Initial power capability of the battery under the specified reference conditions.
notes: D列为通用初始功率，E列残留Initial power at 20% SoC；按通用字段描述，不替用户确定20%/80%或取平均的单值映射。

description: Initial battery power capability measured at 80% state of charge under specified reference conditions.
notes: 80% SOC来自本表工程化细项，不能解释为官方字段指定80%或允许同时填两个SOC值；该字段单值映射仍需确认。

description: Power capability of the battery at its current stage of use under reference conditions.
notes: 不得与公开originalPowerCapability或性能参数powerCapability混为同一字段。

description: Percentage decrease in battery power capability over time and use relative to its initial value.
Permitted battery power limits, including applicable temperature conditions where relevant.
notes: 未将功率限值解释为峰值或持续功率；具体限值和测试条件以实际资料为准。

description: Ratio of nominal battery power to battery energy under the specified reference conditions.
notes: Annex IV Part B测量说明中的工程化参数；官方1.0.0未独立定义该同名字段，不指定未经定义的参考条件。

description: Initial round-trip efficiency, calculated as discharge energy divided by energy needed to restore the initial charge.
Round-trip energy efficiency of the battery under the applicable measurement conditions during use.
notes: 中文为往返能效，旧E/D英文含initial残留；按在用roundTripEnergyEfficiency纠正，不再重复第114行的初始值。

description: Round-trip energy efficiency measured when the battery reaches half of its expected cycle life.
Round-trip energy efficiency representing the battery's condition at the current stage of use.
Percentage decrease in round-trip energy efficiency relative to the specified initial reference value.
Self-discharge rate of an unused battery under reference conditions at the beginning of life.
notes: 工程化初始自放电率拆分项，官方未独立定义initialSelfDischargeRate；本表单位为%/month，官方父项描述提到%/year，单位换算需另行确认，本次不改单位列。

description: Self-discharge rate of the battery at its current age under specified reference conditions.
notes: 工程化当前自放电率拆分项，官方未独立定义currentSelfDischargeRate；不要误写成相对初始值的差值或衰减公式。单位周期同第119行需确认。

description: Recorded evolution of battery self-discharge rates, with the associated measurement timestamps.
notes: 官方为率值及时间记录；不沿用旧中文中未经官方定义的初始值与当前值计算公式。

description: Initial internal resistance of the battery cell measured using the specified DC test method.
notes: DC是工程化细项的明确限定，官方internalCellResistance未独立规定DC或测试时长、频率。

description: Initial internal resistance of the battery pack measured using the specified DC test method.
notes: 以中文电池包为准，纠正E列残留Initial cell DC resistance；DC为工程拆分，官方未单列DC字段。

description: Initial internal resistance of the battery cell measured using the specified AC test method.
notes: AC为工程化细项，官方internalCellResistance未拆分AC/DC，也没有指定统一测试频率。

description: Initial internal resistance of the battery pack measured using the specified AC test method.
notes: AC为工程化细项，官方internalPackResistance未拆分AC/DC，也没有指定统一测试频率。

description: Initial internal resistance of the battery measured under the specified reference conditions.
notes: 保留本表初始内阻含义，删除旧英文中无依据的cell及DC限定；官方internalResistance本身并非专属初始、单电芯或直流测试字段，仍需区分该行与第127行用途。

description: Current internal resistance of the battery measured under the specified reference conditions.
notes: 纠正旧描述Cell resistance measured under DC；官方未限定单电芯、直流测试或具体采样频率。E英文含pack，但该官方字段不固定为电池包级。

description: Percentage increase in battery pack internal resistance relative to its initial reference value.
notes: 电池包层级来自工程化细项；官方字段本身没有限定仅电池包，也未指定测试协议。

description: Expected battery lifetime expressed in calendar years under its design reference conditions.
Expected battery lifetime expressed as a number of charge-discharge cycles.
Expected battery lifetime expressed in cycles under its design reference conditions.
notes: Rest不可解读为remaining；不描述成剩余循环寿命，也不按已用循环作减法。

description: Cumulative number of complete charge-discharge cycles recorded during battery use.
notes: 工程化汇总行，官方1.0.0分别定义充电和放电循环次数，未独立定义本行联合计数或等效折算算法。

description: Cumulative number of charging cycles recorded for the individual battery during use.
notes: 纠正旧英文把充放电合写的问题；不指定插枪次数、单次制动计数或等效循环换算算法。

description: Cumulative number of discharging cycles recorded for the individual battery during use.
notes: 纠正旧英文把充放电合写的问题；不指定单次放电事件或等效循环换算算法。

description: Reference test used to determine the battery's expected lifetime expressed in cycles.
notes: 不指定未由官方字段强制的单一测试标准。

description: Charging C-rate applied in the reference test used to determine expected cycle life.
notes: 按工程化充电细项表述，不再同时描述充放电两个倍率。

description: Discharging C-rate applied in the reference test used to determine expected cycle life.
notes: 按工程化放电细项表述，不再同时描述充放电两个倍率。

description: Cumulative energy throughput of the battery over its service life up to the measurement time.
notes: 本工程化指标没有官方1.0.0独立同名字段；未自行规定充入与放出能量是否相加的统计边界。

description: Cumulative capacity throughput of the battery over its service life up to the measurement time.
notes: 本工程化指标没有官方1.0.0独立同名字段；未自行规定充入与放出电量是否相加的统计边界。

description: SOCE percentage threshold used to determine whether an EV battery remains operational.
Histogram of periodically recorded operating temperatures experienced during battery use.
notes: 描述温度分布记录，不误写成当前瞬时温度；未指定记录或上报间隔。

description: Temperature range the battery can withstand when not in use under specified reference conditions.
notes: D名称为温度下限、E和格式均为温度范围；按父对象整体范围表述，不仅写下限，也不混为工作温度范围。

description: Cumulative time spent above the upper temperature limit specified for the battery.
notes: 工程化高温累计时间拆分项；官方1.0.0未定义同名标量字段，具体阈值及由直方图汇总规则另行确定。

description: Cumulative time spent below the lower temperature limit specified for the battery.
notes: 工程化低温累计时间拆分项；官方1.0.0未定义同名标量字段，具体阈值及由直方图汇总规则另行确定。

description: Cumulative charging time at temperatures above the upper limit specified for the battery.
notes: 工程化高温充电时间拆分项；官方直方图没有独立充电状态维度，不能据普通温度直方图直接认定可计算，需充电状态原始记录。

description: Cumulative charging time at temperatures below the lower limit specified for the battery.
notes: 工程化低温充电时间拆分项；官方直方图没有独立充电状态维度，不能据普通温度直方图直接认定可计算，需充电状态原始记录。

description: Information on accidents affecting the battery, including incidents involving the equipment it powers.
notes: 事故为官方negativeEvents示例，不将所有负面事件都缩为事故。

description: Number of recorded events in which battery voltage falls below its specified operating limit.
notes: 工程化深度放电计数拆分项；官方negativeEvents未单列此数字字段或规定电压阈值、去抖及单次事件算法。

description: Number of recorded events in which battery voltage exceeds its specified upper operating limit.
notes: 工程化过充事件计数拆分项；官方negativeEvents未单列此数字字段或规定电压阈值、去抖及单次事件算法。

description: Rated capacity of the battery under specified reference conditions, expressed in ampere-hours.
notes: 不将ratedCapacity描述成实际剩余可用容量；动态属性不等于任意时刻的remainingCapacity，也没有从字段定义得出固定更新频率。
